clog-1: Bee privada nian la tun liu no sai fali mai liur
clog-2: Sasán ruma (lensu bokon, eskova nehan, tampu) monu ba privada laran
clog-3: Kozinha nia labatour iis aat no bee nalihun
clog-4: Bee fakar sai husi kanku labatour kraik ka husi rai
clog-5: Rai-kuak sintina nian nakonu ho fuuk no bee sai fali mai liur
clog-6: Kanku fase-fatin ka varanda nian sobu sai bee no kfoam
clog-7: Kanku boot ba foer ka kuak boot iha edifísiu nian travadu
clog-8: Presiza ezame laran kanku nian ho kámara endoskópiu
clog-9: Presiza hamoos kanku ho presaun bee maka'as
clog-10: Problema iha kanku ba tanke foer nian no bee fila fali
clog-11: Kanku maquina harahun hahan nian travadu tanba mina-bokur maran
clog-12: Hamoos fatin mina-bokur nian no loke kanku ba restorante/loja
leak-1: Bee turuk ka halo bokon uma kraik nia tetu ka didin
leak-2: Kontadór bee nian kontinua la'o maski la uza bee
leak-3: Didin-tahan, rai ai-kabelak ka tapete okos bokon no mofo
leak-4: Torneira nia ligasaun kontinua turuk bee la para
leak-5: Bee suli husi privada nia hun ka husi tanke nia sasán
leak-6: Kanku bee nian nakfera ka kontadór bee jelu tanba tempu malirin
leak-7: Torneira hasai bee mean ferrujen ka rai-henek/foer
leak-8: Kanku boiler nian ka válvula fahe manas nian suli bee
leak-9: Udan-been tama husi didin liur nia nakfera ka janela nia silikone
leak-10: Koko buka bee-fakar ne'ebé ki'ik liu ho aparéllu son ka gás avansadu
leak-11: Presaun bee nian krekas liu, husu instala bomba presaun
leak-12: Troka kanku bee tuan hotu no halo fali impermeabilizasaun ba sintina
bl-1: Boiler lakan hela, maibé kuartu la manas liu ida
bl-2: Bainhira hariis bee manas la sai, bee malirin de'it mak sai
bl-3: Kódigu erru nian lakan-mate iha termóstatu kuartu laran nian
bl-4: Bee turuk husi kaldeira laran ka husi kadoras kraik nian
bl-5: Lian tarutu maka'as ka lian barullu bainhira kaldeira hahú lakan
bl-6: Iis gás ka suar husi kadoras exhaustu tama mai kuartu laran
bl-7: Bomba sirkulasaun aat; bee nia lian rona maibé laiha manas
bl-8: Husu folin ba troka foun kaldeira gás kondensasaun ekolójiku
bl-9: Termóstatu kuartu ida-idak nian aat ka atuadór válvula nian la funsiona
bl-10: Presiza fase kadoras manas nian (hasai fo'er/ferrujen) no hasai anin
bl-11: Inspesaun & hadi'a kaldeira mina / elétriku / karvaun
bl-12: Hamanas kadoras kaldeira nian ne'ebé jelu no instala fali izolamentu
clean-1: Hamoos molok muda ba hela iha estúdiu/apartamentu (Dezinfeksaun kompletu)
clean-2: Hamoos kle'an mina-sarani iha fogon/exaustór kuziña nian & pia
clean-3: Hamoos fo'er mutin, lodo iha azuleju haris-fatin & desinfeta sintina
clean-4: Hasai rai-rahun husi moldura janela, rede no fase vidru sorin rua
clean-5: Kore jeladeira nia parte laran hodi hamoos ho suar manas & hasai iis fo'er
clean-6: Kore ar-kondisionadu hodi fase filtru & hamoos fo'er ho presaun maka'as
clean-7: Kore mákina fase-roupa nia bidon hodi dezinfefta kle'an & hasai fo'er
clean-8: Hamoos rai ho mákina hodi hasai fo'er metin & fó sera protesaun
clean-9: Hasai kutun husi kolxaun / sofá hena ho fase bokon kle'an & dezinfefta
clean-10: Hamoos espesiál ba uma fo'er/akumulasaun fo'er (Fai fo'er boot & hasai iis)
clean-11: Hamoos depois de konstrusaun (Hasai rai-rahun simentu, manxas tinta)
clean-12: Hasai animál nia fulun/iis fo'er & dezinfefta ho suar fitonsida ekolójiku

h-9: Fatin hela ne'ebé bele lori animál-estimasaun (asat/busa)
